name: narrator
source: Thorsten Müller, Thorsten-Voice German neutral corpus, OpenSLR 95
licence: CC0 per openslr.org/95; Zenodo's metadata for the same corpus says CC BY 4.0, so it is attributed either way
note: A German speaker who released his voice so that people could build German speech with it, which is exactly this use. One continuous 10.5 s take, 22.05 kHz mono, already level-normalised and free of leading and trailing silence.
